name: expense-routing-v2
description: Route Meridian Consulting employee expense claims to the correct approval queue and tag the spending category, per the routing policy and its travel and software addenda.
datagen_guidance: The claim must genuinely require the target routing under the policies (precedence: reject > needs_finance > needs_manager > auto_approve). State amounts explicitly and mention receipt status when it matters. Derive the category from what was purchased, not why.

personas: consultant back from a client site visit
new hire filing their first expenses

auto_approve: a small meal, travel, or office-supply purchase under $75 with a receipt attached
needs_manager: a mid-range purchase between $75 and $500 with a receipt
a purchase of any size where the receipt is missing
a team meal with three or more employees
needs_finance: a recurring software subscription of any amount
reject: a personal item or personal subscription
